- Added the Master guide for Ghommal’s hilt 5 at the standard 1,965 points. Choose **Solo**, **With a group**, or **Raid-light**. Suggestions use your remaining points and unfinished achievements across tiers.
- The Master checklist covers 655 achievements, including 173 Master-ranked tasks. Cards show gear and unlock checks, party size where needed, and walkthrough links. Medium, Hard, Elite, and Master share your progress, skips, and preparation.
- **Show task on screen** displays the title and objective in a smaller translucent note. Use the sidebar for the full task details.
- If the guide needs to verify your personal Group Ironman Master target, it directs you to the in-game rewards tab.
